## Proposed correction

Explain the smallest wording, evidence-date, reproduction, ownership, or limitation correction. Prefer a downgrade when current proof is missing.

## Evidence

Link only to public source files or describe a secret-free local reproduction command. Do not attach raw private logs or provider payloads.

## Boundary confirmation

- [ ] This correction does not make a provider route, plugin, installer, security channel, or contribution path appear more qualified than its evidence allows.
